_readme: Screenshots of the four browser games, for the cards on /games/.
Written by scripts/sync-game-shots.mjs. Do not hand-edit: `w` and `h` are the
decoded size of the file and the builder emits them as width/height.
Rerun the script after any change to a game or these go stale, which nothing
else in the build can detect for you.

garbage-run.shows: The Garbage Run title screen: GARBAGE RUN in blocky 8-bit capitals above ROCHESTER, NY and GARBAGE RIPS 585, with Trubbish sitting on a Garbage Plate and TAP TO START underneath

whos-that-pokemon.shows: Who's That Pokemon mid-round: a Pokemon blacked out to a silhouette, with four names to choose from underneath

guess-the-set.shows: Guess the Set mid-round: a full scan of a real Pokemon card, with four set names to choose from underneath

pokemon-trivia.shows: Pokemon Trivia mid-round: a question in large type, with four answers to choose from underneath
